public_rationale: The records reviewed do not establish the predicted collapse and its cause. Google documented a repaired outage, while Alphabet described human review of agent-written code. Neither settles this indefinite forecast. The absence of a qualifying event by the evaluation date is not a failed prediction.
limitations: Public incident reports may omit internal development details.
Company descriptions of oversight are not independent audits.
The interpretation of collapse excludes isolated, repaired outages.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At some point, these ugly messes (large companies that have given up on managing their people in favour of automation) will collapse, as it becomes clear that their entire infrastructure is built on increasingly automated, hallucination-ridden work with no human touch.
conditions: these ugly messes: companies that have given up on managing people in favour of automation

statement.excerpt: At some point, these ugly messes will collapse as it becomes clear that their entire infrastructure is written upon increasingly-automated levels of crap, rife with hallucinations and devoid of any human touch.

our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion identifies Microsoft and Google as examples, but does not define an exhaustive set of companies.
The ordinary reading of collapse is a major business or sustained operational breakdown. An isolated, repaired outage is insufficient.
The forecast includes a mechanism: dependence on defective automated work must materially contribute to the breakdown.
The descriptions of automation are asserted premises, not an explicit conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Public records establish a collapse within the described company scope, and credible technical investigations connect it materially to dependence on defective automated infrastructure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive event permanently rules out the specified outcome for a clearly defined target scope. Continued operation, human oversight today, or improved software alone cannot disprove an indefinite forecast.

evidence.explanation: Google documents a 49-minute disruption caused by a software-update bug. It does not identify AI-generated code as the cause or establish sustained operational collapse.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A documented collapse at clearly identified target companies, accompanied by investigations establishing the claimed automation-related cause. A defined target scope would also be needed to resolve the plural claim fully.
